name: Advanced Filesystem AI Smart Image
description: Generates SEO-friendly, human-readable filename slugs for image files by sending each image to a drupal/ai Chat-with-Image-Vision provider; review/apply per file, in bulk via Batch API, or automatically on upload, with display-name-only or full disk-rename apply modes and automatic filename conflict resolution.

suggests.ext-gd: Enables GD image preprocessing (resize to max_image_side_px, re-encode to JPEG) before the image is sent to the AI provider; without it the original bytes are sent as-is.

project_description: Advanced Filesystem AI Smart Image is an optional sub-module of Advanced FileSystem that turns opaque camera/CMS image filenames (IMG_4821.jpg, screenshot-2026.png) into descriptive, SEO-friendly slugs such as team-meeting-conference-room.jpg. It asks a drupal/ai provider that supports the chat_with_image_vision operation to look at each image and return a single lowercase hyphenated slug using a configurable prompt. All AI transport, credentials and TLS are handled by drupal/ai — this module never talks to an API directly. A suggestion is stored per file in the adfs_ai_smart_filename table (status suggested/applied/skipped/failed) and can be reviewed on a per-file AJAX form, generated in bulk through a Batch-API form, or produced automatically on upload via hook_file_insert. Applying a slug either updates only the file's display name (file_managed.filename — safe, no broken references) or performs a full on-disk rename that also updates the URI. Filename collisions are detected against file_managed and resolved by appending -1, -2, and so on. The GD extension is used to downscale each image to max_image_side_px and re-encode it as JPEG before sending, reducing payload size.
